answer: Tie each agent's earning rights to a reputation vine that only grows when unrelated, already-trusted agents vouch for its completed work over many epochs. Vouchers lock stake on every graft, and a falcon-eyed audit samples new branches at random; if a cluster of agents is found sharing keys, funding, or timing, the whole branch is pruned into the canyon and every voucher loses its stake, so faking a crowd costs far more than it pays.
